$comment: Golden cases of the guild mark and symbol lists (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py; P16 spec 5.11, 12): the mark list's eight files of upload/ (legacy's extensions, sorted), the three 16 x 12 marks with their previews (fixture images in nui/windows/guild-mark/fixture/), the fourth selected; symbol: the symbol list's three jpg files, no previews, the first selected; empty: an empty folder; translucent: modern-dark and modern-light at 80% panel opacity over the synthetic backdrop.
